output_dir: D:\FILES\糖蛋蛋(＾Ｕ＾)ノ~ＹＯ\AI绘本\星空-太阳浮岛之旅-EN

texts_per_file.0010.png: On a hot summer afternoon, the asphalt road was softened by the scorching sun. Little Candy leaned on the cool balcony railing, holding a thin sheet of mica, through which she observed the sun in the sky. The mica acted like a filter, turning the dazzling sunlight into gentle orange-red, and she was surprised to find faint dark spots on the sun’s surface.
texts_per_file.0020.png: Just then, the Star Luo Bracelet on Little Candy’s wrist suddenly beeped and lit up with blue light. The light shimmered like a flowing little star in the sun. It was a token left by her mysterious friend Star Luo, usually quiet, only glowing when something special was about to happen.
texts_per_file.0030.png: "Meow!" Tom, dressed in a blue sailor suit, jumped out from under the sunshade, holding a small ball in his paw. He had wanted to invite Little Candy to play, but after just two steps, he was burned by the hot ground and quickly hid back under the shade, pressing his belly against the mat to cool down and panting with his tongue out.
texts_per_file.0040.png: "Hahaha, Tom, are you afraid of the heat?" Jerry popped out from behind the flower pot. Wearing red overalls, he held three treasures: a homemade light-energy slingshot, mini sunglasses, and a glowing piece of mica. He put on the sunglasses and spun around proudly in the sun, showing off he wasn’t afraid of the sun.
texts_per_file.0050.png: "Squeak! Jerry, wait for me!" Tuffy, a small gray-blue mouse, ran over with a transparent backpack full of colorful rainbow gummies. He was out of breath, his short legs pattering on the mat, eating candies from his bag as he ran, completely unaffected by the heat.
texts_per_file.0060.png: Heavy footsteps came from the balcony door, and tall, strong Spike walked in. He wore an old belt around his neck and a large sun-protection cloak, yet sweat still beaded on his forehead. He shouted loudly: "It’s so hot! So hot! Tyke, don’t run too far!"
texts_per_file.0070.png: "Dad, wait for me!" Chubby Tyke followed. His glowing sandals lit up with every step, shining in colorful lights. Energetic and fearless of the heat, he tried to run into the sun to chase butterflies, but Spike picked him up at once.
texts_per_file.0080.png: Just then, the light of the Star Luo Bracelet grew brighter, and a golden glow slowly gathered in the middle of the balcony. Little Candy’s eyes widened in surprise as Star Luo appeared.
texts_per_file.0090.png: Star Luo said: "Little Candy, Tom, Jerry, Tuffy, Spike, Tyke — are you ready to take a walk on the sun? There is no fire, only roads made of light, winds made of songs, and sun people who have been waiting for us for a long time!"
texts_per_file.0100.png: "A walk on the sun?" Tom jumped up from the mat at once, his tail held high, forgetting the heat. Jerry took off his sunglasses, his eyes sparkling with curiosity. Everyone looked at each other, doubtful yet excited.
texts_per_file.0110.png: Star Luo smiled gently, the golden light particles inside spinning faster: "The sun’s surface is indeed 5500°C, but we’re going to the corona cooling layer — a safe, walkable light-space, warm and comfortable."
texts_per_file.0120.png: Star Luo leaped lightly, and a spiral staircase woven from light rose from the ground. The steps glittered, leading straight up into the clouds. "Hold hands tightly — let’s take a walk on the sun!" invited Star Luo.
texts_per_file.0130.png: Little Candy excitedly held out her hand and first took Tom’s. Tom held Spike’s, Spike picked up Tyke, Jerry held Tuffy, and Tuffy finally took Little Candy’s other hand. Everyone held hands in a long line.
texts_per_file.0140.png: They carefully stepped onto the light stairs. The steps were soft, like walking on a rainbow made of cotton candy, not slippery at all. "Wow, so comfortable!" Little Candy sighed. The stairs carried a faint warmth, like a mother’s hug.
texts_per_file.0150.png: They walked slowly up the stairs, passing through a thin golden mist. The mist was soft, cool on the cheeks, and sweet-smelling. After passing through, the scene before them left everyone stunned.
texts_per_file.0160.png: The ground was warm amber-colored glass, making a soft tapping sound when stepped on; rivers were flowing golden threads, shimmering brightly; trees had crystal branches hanging with round light fruits; when the wind blew, the leaves sang "la — la —".
texts_per_file.0170.png: In the distance, a group of translucent "sun people" waved to welcome them. Their bodies were pale gold, their hair dancing light threads, and their voices sounded like a wind chime ensemble: "Welcome to the Heliocentric Garden! Welcome to the Sun Floating Island!"
texts_per_file.0180.png: Little Candy let go and slowly stepped onto the amber ground; the glass under her feet was warm, not hot at all. "Is this really the sun? It’s amazing!" she turned to her companions behind her.
texts_per_file.0190.png: Star Luo followed beside them: "This is the Sun Floating Island, made of solidified sunlight, crystal forests, and light-flowing rivers. The sun releases huge energy every second, but here it turns into gentle ‘light language’."
texts_per_file.0200.png: Everyone calmed down and listened carefully. They indeed heard a faint buzzing sound, like countless little bees singing softly or a gentle whisper. Jerry curiously went up to a crystal tree, pressing his ear to the trunk: "I really hear sounds! Is this the light language?"
texts_per_file.0210.png: A little sun girl came over. Her light-thread hair was pink, and she looked like a child. "I’m Xixi, a child of the sun," she greeted with a smile, her voice like sweet honey water. "I’ll take you to the Light Crystal Garden — there are delicious Quiet Light Fruits there."
texts_per_file.0220.png: "Quiet Light Fruits? What tasty treat is that?" Tuffy’s eyes lit up, and he hurried forward with his transparent backpack. He was most sensitive to the words "delicious food". Xixi turned to lead the way, and everyone followed.
texts_per_file.0230.png: Xixi led everyone into a garden full of light flowers. The petals were made of transparent crystal in various colors, each glowing softly. Round fruits grew on the grass — Quiet Light Fruits, smooth and small like lanterns.
texts_per_file.0240.png: Xixi picked a Quiet Light Fruit and handed it to Little Candy: "This is a special fruit of the Sun Floating Island. One bite, and the noise in your heart will calm down. Try it."
texts_per_file.0250.png: Little Candy took the fruit, feeling its warmth, and bit gently. The flesh was sweet with a faint floral scent. After eating, her heart truly calmed down, and her earlier excitement turned into gentle peace.
texts_per_file.0260.png: Tom watched greedily and wanted a taste too. He clumsily jumped to pick a fruit from the tree but didn’t jump high enough and nearly fell. Xixi smiled and picked one for him: "Here, eat slowly."
texts_per_file.0270.png: Tom took the fruit and swallowed it whole, loving the taste. Overexcited, he asked for two more and ate them in one go. Right after, he tried to sneeze but only made a weak "Ah — …?" sound, as if his mouth was covered.
texts_per_file.0280.png: Tuffy laughed hysterically at Tom’s look and accidentally rolled into a nearby patch of light grass. The grass was soft like cotton and bounced him up. "Hahaha, Tom, you’ve gone mute!"
texts_per_file.0290.png: Tom gestured anxiously, trying to speak but making no sound, his face turning red. Jerry clapped and laughed: "That’s what you get for eating too many! Too many Quiet Light Fruits even quiet your voice!"
texts_per_file.0300.png: Spike couldn’t help laughing either and patted Tom’s shoulder: "Don’t worry, it’ll pass soon." Tyke circled around Tom, his glowing sandals flashing, finding Tom’s look very funny.
texts_per_file.0310.png: Xixi handed Tom a cup of light-flowing river water: "Drink this, you’ll feel better faster." Tom quickly took the cup and drank greedily. Everyone watched with concern.
texts_per_file.0320.png: Sure enough, after a while, Tom could speak again, though softly — at least he could talk. "Thank you," he said shyly, not daring to eat too many at once anymore.
texts_per_file.0330.png: Jerry pulled out his light-energy slingshot, took a rainbow gummy from Tuffy’s backpack, and loaded it. "Watch this!" He pulled the slingshot tight and let go into the sky. "Puff —" the gummy shot out, suddenly bursting into a tiny, sparkling star.
texts_per_file.0340.png: "Wow! So beautiful!" Little Candy and Tyke exclaimed excitedly. The little star made of candy floated in the air, shining with soft colorful light, lighting up their surprised faces.
texts_per_file.0350.png: Jerry smiled proudly and shot several more gummies one by one. Each turned into a little star in the sky, attracting many light butterflies. Their transparent wings glowed in colors, dancing around the stars like a lively party.
texts_per_file.0360.png: Instead of being angry that his gummies were used, Tuffy clapped happily: "Cousin Jerry, shoot another one! I want a purple star!" He held his backpack high for Jerry to take freely.
texts_per_file.0370.png: Jerry granted his wish and shot a purple rainbow gummy. A purple little star appeared in the sky, drawing a group of purple light butterflies. Tuffy happily chased the butterflies but accidentally fell into a soft gummy cloud.
texts_per_file.0380.png: The gummy cloud was like cotton candy, wrapping him up sweetly. "Help!" Tuffy struggled in the cloud but sank deeper. Everyone rushed over, and Spike reached out his big hand to pull him out.
texts_per_file.0390.png: Tuffy was covered in sweet gummy juice, like a little sticky mouse. "Hahaha, Tuffy, you’ve become a gummy mouse!" Jerry laughed, pulling out a glowing piece of mica to wipe the juice off Tuffy.
texts_per_file.0400.png: Little Candy went to Xixi and asked curiously: "Xixi, aren’t you hot living here? When I’m on Earth, I want to hide in an air-conditioned room even when it’s a little hot in summer." She wiped sweat from her forehead that wasn’t there.
texts_per_file.0410.png: Xixi smiled, her light-thread hair floating gently: "The sun is not fire — it’s a hug made of light. The temperature here is just right, and we all love it. Besides, our bodies are made of light, different from yours." She pointed to her translucent body.
texts_per_file.0420.png: Xixi pointed to the distant light-flowing river: "That river is made of light. In summer, we even swim in it!" In the golden river, several sun people frolicked like glowing fish.
texts_per_file.0430.png: Little Candy nodded. The Star Luo Bracelet suddenly lit up, showing a line of small words: The average distance from the Sun to Earth is about 150 million kilometers; sunlight takes 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth. Little Candy read it aloud and asked Star Luo: "What does 8 minutes and 20 seconds mean?"
texts_per_file.0440.png: Star Luo’s voice sounded like wind chimes: "It means the sunlight we see now left the sun 8 minutes and 20 seconds ago. That’s about as long as you brush your teeth, put on your shoes, and give your mom a hug!" Star Luo used light particles to mimic brushing teeth and putting on shoes.
texts_per_file.0450.png: "I see!" Little Candy understood. "So the sun I see when I wake up in the morning is actually what it looked like 8 minutes ago?" She stroked her chin thoughtfully, looking at the sky.
texts_per_file.0460.png: "Exactly!" Xixi nodded. "Earth is very, very far from us — light takes a long time to get there. But whenever you look up at the sun, we can feel your gaze!" Xixi put her hands together in a "feeling" gesture.
texts_per_file.0470.png: In the afternoon, the wind grew softer and the sunlight gentler. Xixi said: "Let’s go to Echo Valley. It’s fun there — you can learn the light language." Everyone followed Xixi in a line toward the valley.
texts_per_file.0480.png: They reached Echo Valley with crystal walls shining brightly. Xixi said: "Shout ‘hello’ to the valley, and the echo will turn into colorful light waves." She shouted "Hello!" to the valley first.
texts_per_file.0490.png: An echo came at once, along with a golden light wave floating in the air like a golden ribbon. "Amazing! I want to try!" Tyke ran excitedly to the valley edge and shouted: "Ice cream!"
texts_per_file.0500.png: An echo returned, and a pink light wave appeared like a huge cotton candy, rushing toward Tyke and nearly sweeping him away. Spike quickly reached out and held him in his arms.
texts_per_file.0510.png: "Wow! So exciting! I want to do it again!" Tyke clapped excitedly, unafraid. He shouted to the valley: "Chocolate!" This time a brown light wave came, gently brushing his warm cheek.
texts_per_file.0520.png: Tuffy also wanted to try and shouted: "Rainbow gummies!" A colorful light wave rushed over, carrying a sweet scent. Tuffy jumped happily: "It smells like gummies!"
texts_per_file.0530.png: Jerry rolled his eyes and shouted: "Tom is stupid!" A green light wave appeared in the valley, carrying Jerry’s echo. Tom chased Jerry angrily: "Jerry, don’t run!"
texts_per_file.0540.png: The two chased each other around the valley, their laughter filling the air. Tyke found it funny and shouted "stinky socks!" to the valley.
texts_per_file.0550.png: A purple light wave appeared, carrying a strange smell just like real stinky socks. "Eww, stinky!" Everyone covered their noses, and Tyke laughed sheepishly.
texts_per_file.0560.png: Star Luo smiled and said: "Echo Valley sends out light waves of different colors and scents based on your mood and words. This is also a kind of light language!" Star Luo glowed as he explained the principle.
texts_per_file.0570.png: After playing for a while, everyone followed Xixi to the Solar Flame Library. Its roof was made of transparent crystal, and sunlight streamed in, making the whole library sparkle. There were no bookshelves inside — only floating colorful light balls.
texts_per_file.0580.png: "These light balls are books?" Little Candy asked curiously, reaching to touch the nearest blue one. Xixi encouraged her: "Just touch it, and you’ll see the story!"
texts_per_file.0590.png: Little Candy gently touched the blue light ball, which burst into a scene: sun people picking Quiet Light Fruits in the Light Crystal Garden. She touched a yellow one, and the scene showed a beautiful sunrise over the Sun Floating Island.
texts_per_file.0600.png: Jerry touched a green light ball, showing the growth of light butterflies. Tuffy touched a pink one, full of candies, making his mouth water.
texts_per_file.0610.png: Little Candy touched a white light ball, which showed glowing words and a voice: "Earth children receive our good morning after 8 minutes and 20 seconds." Little Candy marveled at the wonder of science.
texts_per_file.0620.png: Spike saw a large orange light ball and touched it curiously. Snoring light mist sprayed out, and Spike yawned widely, leaning against the wall and falling asleep, snoring loudly.
texts_per_file.0630.png: "Hahaha, Dad fell asleep!" Tyke laughed, poking Spike’s cheek gently. Xixi explained it was the "Snoring Light Book", recording the sleeping stories of the Sun Floating Island residents.
texts_per_file.0640.png: Everyone tiptoed away from Spike and kept exploring. Little Candy touched a purple light ball, which explained sunspots: "Sunspots are the sun’s thinking spots."
texts_per_file.0650.png: Star Luo nodded: "The sun is 4.6 billion years old. It has been thinking about how to shine its light and heat better to warm the whole solar system." Star Luo’s body glowed with ancient, wise light.
texts_per_file.0660.png: Just then, the library suddenly dimmed, and the light weakened greatly. Everyone was shocked. Tyke hurried to shake Spike awake: "Dad, Dad, it’s dark!"
texts_per_file.0670.png: Xixi looked worried: "The sunspots have dimmed. When the sun thinks deeply, its light weakens. At this time, we need children’s laughter to recharge the sun and make it bright again."
texts_per_file.0680.png: "We’ll help!" Little Candy said at once. Tuffy volunteered: "I’ll do a funny dance!" He twisted his little body in the middle of the library, pretending to fall and get up again, looking very silly.
texts_per_file.0690.png: Tom also wanted to help. He copied Jerry’s usual moves, running in circles and deliberately tripping himself, rolling onto his back. Jerry joined in, and the two chased and tripped each other, making everyone laugh loudly.
texts_per_file.0700.png: Tyke wore his glowing sandals, stepping out a rhythm, singing as he stomped: "Sun, sun, shine bright again! We’ll play with you!" His shoes flashed a cheerful beat.
texts_per_file.0710.png: Jerry took many rainbow gummies from Tuffy’s backpack and shot them one by one at the sunspots outside the window with his slingshot. Each gummy turned into a little star in the sky, flying toward the sunspots like colorful energy balls.
texts_per_file.0720.png: Everyone’s laughter grew louder, turning into colorful light streams that poured out of the library and into the sunspots. Gradually, the sunspots brightened, and the light of the whole Sun Floating Island grew stronger, returning to warmth and brightness.
texts_per_file.0730.png: An elder sun man with golden light-thread hair walked over. He was tall with gentle eyes and bowed deeply to everyone: "Thank you, brave and lovely children. Your happiness has lit up the sun’s thoughts and filled the island with light again."
texts_per_file.0740.png: "You’re welcome!" Little Candy smiled. "We’re happy to help the sun!" The elder nodded and handed Little Candy a small light box: "This is a gift from the sun. Inside is the Light Language Dictionary, helping you understand the sun’s light language." Little Candy took it with both hands; the box was warm.
texts_per_file.0750.png: Leaving the library, Xixi led everyone to the Three-legged Crow Post Station. Its triangular roof was made of transparent crystal, and three light-woven guardians stood on it — bird-like but with three legs.
texts_per_file.0760.png: Xixi introduced: "The three-legged crows are not real birds, but light-woven guardians. Each leg represents morning, noon, and dusk. They protect the Sun Floating Island and send light messengers to distant planets."
texts_per_file.0770.png: One three-legged crow flew down, holding a small basket in its beak with tiny golden seeds inside. "These are Heliocentric Seeds," it said in a deep voice. "A gift for each of you."
texts_per_file.0780.png: The three-legged crow gave a Heliocentric Seed to everyone. Little Candy held hers in her hand — warm, like holding a little sun. All wore happy smiles.
texts_per_file.0790.png: The sun sank toward the west, and everyone stepped onto the light stairs back to Earth. Star Luo said: "When you feel the world is too noisy and too dark, close your eyes and say ‘Sun, I miss you’ — light will come to you."
texts_per_file.0800.png: The light stairs faded away, and everyone returned to the balcony. Each had a slightly glowing Heliocentric Seed in their pocket. Night fell, and they sat on the rooftop observatory watching the stars, their hearts warm. Little Candy held the seed tightly, dreaming of light.
